translations.web: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father; so he who feeds on me, he will also live because of me.
translations.bsb: Just as the living Father sent Me and I live because of the Father, so also the one who feeds on Me will live because of Me.
translations.kjv: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.
translations.asv: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father; so he that eateth me, he also shall live because of me.
